en.title: Why Nobody Can Forge a Blockchain ⛓️ #Shorts
en.description:
A new page every ten minutes, sealed with its fingerprint and starting with the fingerprint of the page before. Change one number on an old page and every page after it breaks, and the whole network rejects it. No undo button, no clerk to call.

The full report: Blockchain and Bitcoin Mining, Explained Simply | Crypto File 2/6

en.title: Bitcoin Mining: No Pickaxe, No Mine ⛏️ #Shorts
en.description:
